summary.headline: Keystone Realtors Q2 FY27 presales hit a record INR 1,423 crores (+84% YoY), and EBITDA margin rose to 14.5% from 7.1%.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 presales of INR 1,423 crores were the highest ever quarterly figure, with H1 presales at INR 2,041 crores, about 41% of the INR 5,000 crore full-year target. Revenue was INR 497 crores in Q2 and EBITDA more than doubled to INR 74 crores, with PAT of INR 101 crores boosted by a one-line share of Urbania JV profit. Collections were muted at INR 541 crores in Q2, and management expects a sharp H2 pickup to INR 3,000-3,100 crores for the year. Net debt rose to INR 132 crores from negative INR 63 crores as cash was deployed into new projects.

segments.name: Residential (Mumbai MMR)
segments.commentary: Presales led by Luxury and Super Premium categories; H1 FY27 sustenance sales were about 93% of presales, with new launch Ozone Skye contributing about INR 140 crores. Mass-market Urbania is a JV whose LA Fam tower (GDV INR 1,300 crores) delivered a 16% EBITDA margin.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.commentary: 25HQ at Prabhadevi (Grade A, around 200,000 sq ft, lease asset) commenced in Q2 FY27; Linking Road 33Fifteen retail with Ajmera is past sales targets. Thane commercial (about 1.1 million sq ft) is planned to start in FY27 on a lease and sale model.

segments.name: Fund management (Mt K Kapital)
segments.commentary: Second fund announced at USD 450 million with Marubeni Corporation as the Japanese partner.

guidance_outlook: FY27 presales guidance of INR 5,000 crores; H1 delivered 41% of target.
FY27 collections expected at INR 3,000-3,100 crores, with collection efficiency of 70-72%.
FY27 launch GDV target of INR 8,000 crores; about INR 3,000 crores launched so far, with GTB Nagar (first phase GDV INR 2,500 crores) targeted for Q4 FY27 by about February.
FY27 operating cash flow now seen at INR 700-800 crores, with INR 1,000 crores aspirational.
Land and approval spend for FY27 about INR 1,000 crores, implying about INR 500 crores in H2.
Embedded EBITDA margin guidance: 24% on sold inventory and 33% on unsold; mass-market margin expected to rise from 16% to 31%, mainly from Virar JDA unsold share (61% EBITDA margin).
FY30 target of INR 10,000 crores (per management's prior framing) with a four-pronged strategy: Mumbai redevelopment, plotted and other residential, commercial lease, and out-of-town (Nagpur).
capex_capacity: Construction spend rose to INR 547 crores in H1 FY27 from INR 452 crores in H1 FY26 (+21%).
About 12 million sq ft under development across 19 ongoing projects; 4 RERA projects completed in H1 FY27 (1.39 million sq ft), 9-15 months ahead of RERA timelines.
Precast in-house plant being set up with Robin Village Development (Tiong Seng subsidiary, Singapore), which will manufacture and install.
Added 2 projects with GDV INR 547 crores in H1 FY27; 27 projects (INR 31,079 crores GDV) added since FY23, of which 21 are redevelopment.
Launch timing: Dindoshi and Om Nagar slipped to H1 FY28; Dombivli and Avinash Towers (Versova) expected in Q4 FY27.
demand_pricing: Q3 FY27 launch Urbania tower with GDV INR 886 crores (launch value to date about INR 3,128 crores).
Management says sales pattern is 30-40% of stock sold in first 6-8 months, about 40% through the life cycle, and about 20% at completion; no deferred payment schemes were used in Q2.
Urbania mid-mass price band about INR 1-1.5 crores per unit.
Unsold inventory at start of FY27 was INR 12,000 crores.
Business development focus on western suburbs (Versova, Bandra, Andheri, Mahim); close to signing 3 projects of about INR 1,000 crores GDV each.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the high sustenance sales in Q2, and was it without deferred payment schemes?
qa_highlights.answer: Management credited launches of about INR 9,500 crores in FY26; sales are running at the planned pace with no deferred payment schemes. Ozone Skye contributed INR 141 crores.

qa_highlights.question: What margin does the Urbania JV project earn?
qa_highlights.answer: LA Fam tower of Urbania delivered GDV and sales of over INR 1,300 crores at a 16% EBITDA margin, recognised as one line item within PAT.

qa_highlights.question: Why is collections muted and when will they improve?
qa_highlights.answer: H1 collections were about INR 1,141-1,150 crores; Q3 and Q4 collections are expected to roughly double in H2, reaching INR 3,000-3,100 crores for FY27.

qa_highlights.question: What supports the 24% to 33% embedded margin assumption?
qa_highlights.answer: Mainly the mass-market EBITDA moving from 16% to 31%, driven by the Virar JDA where unsold revenue share carries a 61% EBITDA margin versus 28% revenue share on sold portion.

qa_highlights.question: Are Dombivli and other launches slipping, and is INR 8,000 crores launch guidance intact?
qa_highlights.answer: Dindoshi and Om Nagar are now H1 FY28; guidance is maintained on the back of GTB Nagar, Avinash Towers (Versova), two Thane towers and one Dombivli tower.

qa_highlights.question: What are the net debt trajectory and funding needs?
qa_highlights.answer: Net debt rose to INR 132 crores; management sees INR 250-300 crores as adequate cash buffer, will use construction finance post-launch, and sees no near-term need for equity.

qa_highlights.question: What is the land and approval spend in H2 and FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: FY27 total around INR 1,000 crores, implying about INR 500 crores in H2; land and approvals are 80-90% of this. FY28 breakup not given.

risks_watch: Collections must roughly double in H2 to reach INR 3,000-3,100 crores; H1 collections were INR 1,141 crores.
Launch concentration in Q4 FY27 (GTB Nagar INR 2,500 crores first phase, Avinash Towers) carries approval and timing risk; earlier stalemate in approvals has eased.
Dindoshi and Om Nagar slipped to H1 FY28.
Net debt rising as cash is deployed; OCF guidance cut to INR 700-800 crores from the INR 1,000 crore aspiration because of new-project cash drag.
Reported PAT includes one-time-like Urbania JV recognition; sustainability of margin uplift to 24-33% depends on Virar JDA unsold sales.
summary.management_tone: Confident on presales, margins and balance sheet, with clear targets reiterated. Somewhat cautious on cash conversion, having trimmed OCF expectations and deferred some launches, and deflected the question on FY28 approval spend without a number.
key_quotes: This is the highest ever quarterly presales.
Our financial statements have started reflecting the margin profile that we have consistently guided.
Fundamentally, we are speaking about doubling of what we have done in the second half, and that is how it is aligned with the execution also.
No need for the equity capital definitely for the immediate future.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Q2 EBITDA margin rose to 14.5% from 7.1% and H1 to 17.8%, and embedded margin guidance is 24% on sold and 33% on unsold inventory, with mass-market margin expected to rise from 16% to 31% via Virar JDA (61% EBITDA margin on unsold share).

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: About 12 million sq ft under development across 19 projects, Thane commercial (~1.1 million sq ft) planned for FY27, and GTB Nagar (INR 2,500 crores GDV) targeted for Q4 FY27, though Dindoshi and Om Nagar slipped to H1 FY28.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: H1 presales INR 2,041 crores (41% of INR 5,000 crore target) and FY27 launch GDV target of INR 8,000 crores with about INR 3,000 crores launched so far, implying a strong H2 launch and sales ramp.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Land and approval spend is about INR 1,000 crores for FY27 with about INR 500 crores in H2, and management gave no FY28 breakup; a new capex or land-led announcement is plausible but not guided.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 presales target held at INR 5,000 crores with H1 at 41%, and OCF guidance was cut to INR 700-800 crores, so no upgrade signal is evident.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Collections must roughly double to INR 3,000-3,100 crores in H2 from INR 1,141 crores in H1, OCF was cut, and Q4 launch concentration (GTB Nagar, Avinash Towers) carries approval timing risk.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: GTB Nagar first phase (GDV INR 2,500 crores) and Dombivli and Avinash Towers (Versova) are planned for Q4 FY27, with Q3 FY27 Urbania tower (GDV INR 886 crores) also in the pipeline.

rows.label: Record Q2 presales INR 1,423 crores (+84% YoY)
rows.why: Q2 presales of INR 1,423 crores vs INR 772 crores a year ago, with sustenance about 93% of H1 presales and no deferred payment schemes used.

rows.label: Collections must double in H2
rows.why: H1 collections were INR 1,141 crores against a FY27 target of INR 3,000-3,100 crores, implying about INR 1,900-2,000 crores in H2 with collection efficiency at 70-72%.

rows.label: Net debt turned positive
rows.why: Net debt rose to INR 132 crores from negative INR 63 crores as land spend of INR 425 crores in H1 and about INR 500 crores more in H2 is funded, with management relying on construction finance rather than equity.

tone.note: Management was confident on presales, margins and balance sheet and reiterated the INR 5,000 crore presales and INR 8,000 crore launch targets, but was cautious on cash conversion after cutting OCF to INR 700-800 crores and deflected the FY28 approval spend question without a number.
